column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique system-monitoring record identifier. PK.
BIGINT. Total API requests processed. **NULL means API request total not recorded.**. Example: 7728.0.
BIGINT. Total API error count. Example: 4.
REAL. API latency marker in milliseconds. **NULL means latency not measured.**. Example: 547.0.
TEXT. WebSocket subsystem state. Possible values: Connected, Disconnected.
BIGINT. Remaining rate-limit quota. Example: 939. Example: 939.
TEXT. Notes for the last system update. Example: 9340653.
TEXT. Sequence code for deployments. **NULL means sequence code not set.**. Example: 6559236.0. Example: 6559236.0.
REAL. Execution time span metric. **NULL means execution time span not captured.**. Example: 203.0. Example: 203.0.
